prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website ABOUT PAGE comp, 1536×1024 landscape
Input image: Image 1 is the pixel reference for the existing Marc Mansour portfolio. Carry over its navbar chrome, light recycled ruled-paper field, cobalt hairline grid and rules, typographic character, spacing discipline, square controls, restrained paper texture, and overall component finish. Do not copy its homepage content, hero composition, financial diagram, project content, activity grid, or homepage section layout.

Primary request: Design a shippable ABOUT PAGE for Marc Mansour titled “Double-Entry Biography.” It must look like a realistic responsive product UI screenshot, not a poster, mood board, or presentation slide. The governing idea is subtle double-entry bookkeeping: investment-banking work creates recurring technical questions; software development gives Marc a way to investigate and build through them.

Page structure, top to bottom:
1. Preserve the existing desktop navbar character from Image 1. Brand at left: “Marc Mansour”. Navigation in this exact order: “HOME”, “PROJECTS”, “ABOUT”, “RESUME”, “CONTACT”, “BLOG”. Mark ABOUT as active with the existing sparse red proof underline. Keep the small BOOK / PAGE register at right. Use a continuous straight cobalt top rule and vertical separators; no repeated skewed or broken tab shoulders.
2. A compact About-page opening band, not a homepage hero. Mono kicker: “ABOUT / WORKING METHOD”. Editorial serif headline: “Questions in one column. Ways to test them in the other.” Readable intro: “Investment-banking work keeps producing technical questions. Software development gives Marc a way to investigate them, build through them, and return with something inspectable.”
3. The dominant surface is a two-column ledger with two equal vertical rails and four precisely aligned paired rows. Left rail label verbatim: “FINANCE / WHAT IT ASKS”. Right rail label verbatim: “SOFTWARE / WHAT IT MAKES TESTABLE”. Use open ruled rows, not rounded cards. Pair these exact concise entries across the rails:
   01 left “What assumptions shape the decision?” — right “Turn assumptions into explicit inputs.”
   02 left “Where does uncertainty enter?” — right “Model the edge cases.”
   03 left “Which pattern keeps returning?” — right “Build a small working probe.”
   04 left “What would make the trade-off legible?” — right “Publish the method, not a verdict.”
   Use cobalt row lines and a narrow central reconciliation gutter with small understated matching marks, accounting ticks, or line joins. Keep the metaphor subtle, precise, and human.
4. Visibly converge both rails at the bottom into one reconciliation rule or bracket, then three square, ruled destinations in one row:
   “SAVYY” with “Questions made usable in a personal-finance tool.”
   “FIELD NOTES” with “Investigations left open for builders and finance-minded readers.”
   “CONTACT” with “Bring a question worth testing.”
   The convergence should be structural, not decorative: paired lines resolve into these three outcomes.
5. In the CONTACT destination include the primary CTA button verbatim “START A CONVERSATION” and secondary outlined action verbatim “OPEN RÉSUMÉ”. Keep both rectangular, nearly square, accessible, and clearly interactive.
6. Show enough second-fold/page-system content and finish with the existing footer character: a thin deep-ink ledger footer strip with restrained mono indexing, direct navigation, and the same square ruled geometry.

Visual world: preserve the Activity Ledger identity from Image 1. Cool light recycled paper, faint 32px horizontal ruling, subtle paper grain, deep navy ink, cobalt blue structural rules, readable muted blue-gray body text, sparse data-lime match marks, and one rare signal-red proof gesture. Bitter-like sturdy editorial display serif, Open Sans-like readable body, Source Code Pro-like mono labels. High contrast and WCAG-conscious hierarchy. Flat and tactile, not glossy. One dominant move: the paired rails and their visible reconciliation. Remaining regions should be quieter.

Composition/framing: exact 1536×1024 desktop webpage viewport, edge-to-edge browser content with no browser chrome and no device frame. Maintain generous outer gutters, legible body copy, crisp 1px rule geometry, believable navigation and button sizing, and enough below-fold content to establish the full About-page system. Use realistic web layout proportions.

Constraints: no employer names, no job title, no dates, no metrics, no client names, no testimonials, no awards, no invented outcomes, no extra claims. Do not introduce people, portraits, photographs, dashboards, charts, generic icon tiles, or floating cards. Do not copy homepage content. No rounded generic cards, no pills, no gradient, no glassmorphism, no glow, no drop-shadow card stack, no watermark. Render all specified interface text accurately and legibly.
